verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a financial platform, but the evidence pack documents no first-party bulk data export, no open-format downloads such as CSV or JSON statements, and no account-exit or offboarding flow. The CLI and API can read individual resources, but those are developer building blocks that could be used to build an export, not an export capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
